title: Characterizing Scanpath Decoding Pipelines with Perturbation Profiles
abstract: arXiv:2611.11632v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When a scanpath descriptor supports a classification, it is rarely clear what the classification rests on. We propose perturbation profiles. Five transformations each target one stated property of every scanpath (fixation order, the coupling of durations to positions, the duration distribution, orientation and handedness, and fine spatial structure) while preserving a listed set of invariants. The classifier is refit, and the change in participant-held-out AUC is the pipeline's sensitivity to that property. Intervals come from a participant bootstrap that refits the classifier; in simulations they were conservative (99.7% coverage; standard errors about 1.8 times the empirical spread). We profiled nine descriptors on thirteen binary problems from three public datasets, with a within-fold AUC and class-balanced folds and a stated rule for which sensitivities to interpret. translated_title: 基于扰动剖面刻画扫描路径解码流程
translated_abstract: 当一个扫描路径描述符支持某种分类时，该分类究竟依赖于什么往往并不清楚。我们提出了扰动剖面方法：五种变换各自针对扫描路径的一项明确属性（注视顺序、注视时长与位置的耦合关系、时长分布、朝向与手性，以及精细空间结构），同时保持一组列出的不变量。随后重新拟合分类器，参与者留出AUC的变化即为该解码流程对这一属性的敏感度。置信区间来自重新拟合分类器的参与者自助法；在模拟实验中，这些区间表现得较为保守（覆盖率达99.7%；标准误约为经验离散度的1.8倍）。我们在来自三个公开数据集的十三个二分类问题上，对九种描述符进行了剖析，采用折内AUC、类别平衡的折划分，并给出了明确的敏感度解释规则。在565个置信区间中，有95个不包含零；其中80个对池化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出“扰动剖面”方法，通过对扫描路径施加五种分别针对注视顺序、时长—位置耦合、时长分布、朝向手性和精细空间结构的变换并重新拟合分类器，以参与者留出AUC的变化来量化各扫描路径解码流程对各项路径属性的敏感度，并借助保守的参与者自助置信区间实现可解释的归因分析。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "perturbation profiles": five targeted transformations of scanpaths (fixation order, duration–position coupling, duration distribution, orientation and handedness, fine spatial structure) with classifier refitting, using changes in participant-held-out AUC to quantify each decoding pipeline's sensitivity to these properties, supported by conservative participant-bootstrap confidence intervals.
